messages:
deploy-bot: Starting soft-peel blue->green for service `router` v2.3.4 -> v2.4.0. Change window 23:00-01:00 UTC. Traffic plan: 0 -> 10% -> 25% -> 50% -> 100% in ~5m increments. Health gates: p95 <= 250ms, errors <= 0.5% (SRE proposed). Posting step updates. /deploy id=deploy-5601 :rocket:

amanda: Quick check — any DB migrations in this release? want to confirm safe window.

raj: No migrations. This is pure routing/runtime change. I'll watch p95 + 5xx. Suggest bump gate to p95 <= 300ms and err <= 0.75% for this peel.

deploy-bot: Noted. Gates adjusted per SRE: p95=300ms, err=0.75%. Starting 10% now.

deploy-bot: UPDATE: traffic moved to 10% (step 1).

eva: Health probe: `curl -sS https://router-prod/_health | jq .status` -> "ok". Metrics: 4xx 0.15%, 5xx 0.02%, p95 220ms. No red flags so far.

zoe: FYI pinned v2.3.4 for routes customer-a and customer-b until 06:00 UTC (cookie affinity still applied). snippet from router config: `routes:
  - id: customer-a
    pin: v2.3.4`

amanda: Hold at 10% for 10m and confirm before advancing to 25%.

deploy-bot: Held at 10% for 8m, awaiting explicit go.

raj: p95 creeping to 260ms but still under 300ms. No error trend. I'm comfortable advancing.

amanda: go for 25%.

deploy-bot: Advancing to 25% now.

deploy-bot: Progress: 25% -> moving to 50% in ~3m unless blocked.

sre-runbook-bot: Runbook: https://runbooks/internal/bluegreen-peel — rollback cmd: `deployctl rollback deploy-5601` — pages and playbooks linked.

deploy-bot: At 50%: p95 420ms, error rate 1.4%, 5xx spike 0.9% :warning:. Automatic policy: reduce traffic to previous stable (20%) and notify ops.

eva: grabbing edge logs now, seeing repeated `handler timeout` across a handful of nodes. Attaching sample: ```
2026-03-17T23:12:45Z ERROR handler timeout id=abc123 node=eu-west-1
```

amanda: Clamp to 20% immediately and hold. Eva, open INC.

deploy-bot: Traffic clamped to 20% (partial rollback). New policy: slow-peel-back. Incident created INC-9876 and pinged #oncall.

zoe: Adjusted route pins to keep affected sessions on v2.3.4, set cookie-affinity=true. router config updated.

raj: p95 has been >400ms and errors >1% for ~2 minutes — recommending full rollback to v2.3.4.

amanda: Agreed. Preparing for full rollback in 30s. Everyone standby.

deploy-bot: Executing rollback to v2.3.4 now. Draining green (v2.4.0) connections and shifting remaining traffic.

deploy-bot: Rollback complete. v2.4.0 traffic -> 0%. Post-rollback metrics: p95 210ms, errors 0.12%.

deploy-bot: Notes: rollback finished, incident INC-9876 created and assigned. Suspected cause: GC regression in v2.4.0 build `2026-03-17-9f` (preliminary).

amanda: Thanks team. I'll hold the release and add a note in the release docs + changelog that v2.4.0 is blocked until investigation. :white_check_mark:

eva: Uploading logs + heap profiles to INC-9876 now.

raj: Will reproduce locally with the GC knobs and run the perf suite against staging. Will report back.

sre-runbook-bot: Incident auto-created: https://incidents/internal/INC-9876 assigned to oncall.june. Playbook step 2 triggered: collect heap/trace.

amanda: Closing coordination thread here. We'll follow up with a postmortem in the morning. Thanks all. :pray:
